data.name: Faiha
data.gender_notes: Faiha is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'ifah' which means 'to open', 'to make clear'. In the context of names, it symbolizes success and prosperity. The name Faiha carries the meaning “Success, Prosperity” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Faiha usually hope their child will grow to embody success, prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a child who is destined to succeed in all aspects of life and bring joy and beauty to those around her
data.etymology: Faiha belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Success, Prosperity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Faiha total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
